reason: Requires the real server resource-reload lifecycle, vanilla structure consumers, and executor shutdown observation.

preconditions: Install a datapack containing one old valid structure, one current structure, and one intentionally unreadable structure resource.
Start with an empty cache root.
steps: Run a server datapack reload and wait for the reload barrier.
Request all three structures through the real StructureTemplateManager.
Remove the unreadable fixture and run a second reload.
assertions: The first reload keeps the original resource manager and publishes no partial index or overlay generation.
The second reload publishes exactly one complete generation before consumers resume.
Old and current structures decode through vanilla consumers with the target DataVersion policy.

preconditions: Provide enough distinct old structures to keep all configured conversion workers busy.
steps: Begin a reload, then supersede it with another reload at the supported lifecycle boundary.
Stop the server after the final reload barrier completes.
assertions: Only the final generation remains active.
No worker reads a closed resource manager or writes after its generation is retired.
No non-daemon cache worker remains after stop.
